name: interface-specification
description: Specify an interface between components / modules: signatures with types, pre- and post-conditions, invariants, error taxonomy, idempotency + concurrency semantics, complexity + performance bounds, lifetime + ownership rules, stability guarantees (stable / experimental / deprecated), examples with expected outputs. Works for internal module APIs, library APIs, function contracts. Distinct from `api-contract-specification` (external network APIs). Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
